title.narrative: Boosting Sustainable Food Production in Kenya (BSFPK)

description.narrative:
Goal:

To boost food production through promotion of good agricultural practices (more specifically Conservation Agriculture) and enhanced access to subsidized agricultural inputs, technologies and Services


Result Areas:

ü 1. Efficient and climate-resilient agricultural crop production promoted and in practice.

ü 2. Access to subsidized agricultural inputs, technologies and services through mobile-based e-voucher platform.

ü 3. Policy and Institutional support for improved sustainable agriculture and food security
